授業概要
This course is designed to equip post-graduate science students with the skills they need to publicize their research at conferences. Students practice making poster and PowerPoint presentations about their own research, and learn how to write a conference abstract.

Course Plan
Week 1： Introductions and course outline
Week 2： Making better presentations
Week 3： Preparing a poster (Page 19*)
Week 4： Preparing a conference abstract (Page 15*)
Week 5： Sections of an abstract
Week 6： Presentation Q&A
Week 7： Giving a PowerPoint presentation (Page 17*)
Week 8： Pronunciation
Week 9： Noun Phrases
Week 10： Topic Position – Stress Position
Week 11： Avoiding Repetition
Week 12： Transitions
Week 13： An Introduction to Intercultural Communication
Week 14： Intercultural Experiences
Week 15： Final Review and Feedback
